pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check LaCrossView API

devicesToExclude.title: Devices to exclude
devicesToExclude.description: Add devices identifier (ID from logs in debug mode) to exclude from homebridge

locationsToExclude.title: Device locations to exclude
locationsToExclude.description: Device location IDs (from logs in debug mode) to exclude when discovering LaCrosseView devices

fakeGatoEnabled.title: Enable FakeGato
fakeGatoEnabled.description: Enable to send historical data to the Elgato Eve app.

fakeGatoStoragePath.title: FakeGato Storage Path
fakeGatoStoragePath.description: Specify a custom path to save FakeGato history.

windSpeedUnit.title: Wind Speed Unit
windSpeedUnit.description: Unit used for the wind speed shown in HomeKit. HomeKit has no wind sensor type, so the speed appears as a light sensor reading ("lux").

windThreshold.title: Windy Threshold
windThreshold.description: When greater than 0, adds a "Windy" occupancy sensor that is triggered while the wind speed (in the unit above) is at or above this value. Useful for automations.

rainAmountSensor.title: Expose Rain Amount
rainAmountSensor.description: Also add a light sensor whose value ("lux") is the rain total for the period below.

rainUnit.title: Rain Amount Unit
rainUnit.description: Unit used for the rain amount light sensor.

rainWindowMinutes.title: Raining Window
rainWindowMinutes.description: A "Raining" occupancy sensor is added for each rain sensor. It is detected while any rain was recorded in this rolling window.

rainAmountPeriod.title: Rain Amount Period
rainAmountPeriod.description: Rolling period for the rain amount light sensor.

layout.title: Wind Sensors
layout.description: How wind speed sensors are exposed to HomeKit

layout.title: Rain Sensors
layout.description: How rain sensors are exposed to HomeKit

layout.title: Elgato Eve
layout.description: Send history to Elgato Eve App
